items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-11-08
items.q: what was your father's name? Peter Valdeman.

ctx.x: I'm 62. 62. You'll be 63 next month. Yeah. Just about a month from today almost. Uh huh. Can you tell about your father? I know he played music and instruments. Well he, I'll tell you they had a, he used to play in a brass band. They had a brass band. Well in fact they had two brass bands out there. And the Arnold band and the Pickwick band. He used to play in the Pickwick band. They were both reserve bands, not down here. Both reserve bands.

Yeah, both reserve bands. Well first of all, what was your father's name? Peter Valdeman. Peter. He's not living is he? Yeah he's living. Well that's what I wondered. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
